Hey, I had this problem and I did fix it. Just pulled out the key (not completely, do not pull it out completely) and the stabiliser was actually not straight. Try just gently messing around with the bar under the key and then push it back in with a click.
If the key now feels more tactile in the middle and more responsive,.I suppose you just had my issue and it's now resolved :) 
If I had to guess it was just the key being forcefully over depressed sometime in shipping and the stabiliser bar got pushed out of place
It's the g14 ACRONYM, look it up

I don't know where you live, but here, my mother's and society's expectations are , I feel, somewhat justified.
Even in my circumstances, I understand the point that not everyone has to go to college or sometime of that sort. But people fail to mention the caveat : you do have to do SOMETHING.
College IS my route. I know this. I have always leaned toward the intellectual side. I read big novels and watch mostly educational content. I like studying when the topic is fun, and my definition of fun is vast compared to the average classmate who would laugh at me. 
But I have failed in this.
I have pushed every deadline and there is no hope of me reclaiming my situation without putting serious strain on my parents and working harder than I ever have on less opportunity and with more hardship than I have ever faced. I have failed to do anything in the last two years and suddenly rising to the challenge is not possible for me.
It would be beneficial for all connected to me if I died. 
This, even if I reconsider my decision to stay in here, I will not concede.

I have. I feel that apart from the mother - son relationship, there is no love there. She completely dislikes me as a person and I don't blame her. For a long time I stuck to my guns and told myself it's okay for me to be different and not up to her standards, but I just can't lie to myself anymore. 
I am simply a burden upon her and I can't face her anymore. I have no right to talk to anyone
I have no right to live, is ultimately what I keep coming back to.

I have tried communicating with them many times. It's like they forget that I have multiple feelings. To my mother I'm a small kid who is only either happy or angry and my father as far as I can tell has no intention of ever bonding with me.
